TT needs a true propane/isobutane cut, not the current butane/isopentane cut; substantially more reflux and boil-up should fix this. N-hexane/methylcyclopentane are close boilers, so B needs many stages. BB should take methylcyclopentane+cyclohexane overhead and C7+ bottoms.

B needs extra stages/reflux because N-hexane/methylcyclopentane are close boilers. BB was costing $115M/yr without a sellable product, so remove it. Full C6-paraffin revenue is about $1.1B/yr, making its purity the top priority.

Full expected blend revenue is about $2.0B/yr.
